title: Raid Boss Gyrocopter (6 Beast)

body:
# Raid Boss Gyrocopter (6 Beast)

This is a one-carry raid-boss comp. Gyrocopter isn't naturally an Ogre, but if you equip it with **Ogre Hood** it gains the Ogre trait and, at the start of every fight, eats the lower-level allies packed around it — inheriting 60% of each victim's HP and base damage. Feed it your whole board and it balloons into a 6,000+ HP, ~1,000-base-damage monster that most lobbies simply cannot kill. Around it you run **6 Beast**, whose 6-tier effect stacks a physical-damage-taken debuff on whatever your team hits, so Gyrocopter's already-huge attacks land even harder.

Be upfront about the trade-off: this build is item- and unit-intensive and needs a lot of luck. You need a 2-star Gyrocopter, six Beasts, *and* the transformation item, and until all three come online (usually round 25–30) you are fragile. Once it clicks, Gyrocopter with Blink Dagger + crit + Manta illusions (each illusion inherits its enormous HP) is close to unbeatable.

> **Note on the transformation item.** The video calls the key item an "Ogre Cap" (and mentions a purple "Cloak of the Tyrant" alternative). Neither of those exists in this project's item data — the only Gyro-into-Ogre item present is **Ogre Hood** (tier 5), so that's what the build and planner link use. If you have two natural Ogres (Alchemist / Ogre Magi) on board you can instead trigger Gyro's transform through the 2-Ogre trait and skip the item.

## Core Units

| Unit | Cost | Synergies | Role |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Gyrocopter | 5 | Dwarf, Mech | The raid boss; wears Ogre Hood, eats the board |
| Primal Beast | 5 | Beast, Warrior | Beast + tanky disable |
| Monkey King | 4 | Beast, Monk | Beast body / tank |
| Lone Druid | 4 | Beast, Druid | Beast + bear tank, HP for Gyro to eat |
| Venomancer | 3 | Aqir, Beast, Warlock | Beast + slow wards |
| Enchantress | 1 | Beast, Centaur, Druid | 6th Beast *and* 2nd Centaur (Stampede) |
| Tusk | 1 | Beast, Warrior | Cheap 6th Beast filler |
| Magnus | 4 | Assassin, Centaur | Stampede charge + AoE stun (wants Minotaur Horn) |
| Sniper | 2 | Dwarf, Hunter | 2nd Dwarf → boosts Gyrocopter's damage |
| Arc Warden | 5 | Kobold, Shaman | Late duplication + summons to soak targeting |

Six distinct Beasts (Primal Beast, Monkey King, Lone Druid, Venomancer, Enchantress, Tusk) turn on the physical-damage debuff. Magnus + Enchantress give you 2 Centaur — the "Stampede" charge-and-stun that sets up the pack for Gyro to clean. Gyrocopter + Sniper is 2 Dwarf for extra damage; the guide's own biggest regret was not securing the Dwarf/Sniper piece sooner.

## Items

- **Ogre Hood (tier 5)** on Gyrocopter — the enabler; without it (or two board Ogres) the build doesn't exist past round 25.
- **Blink Dagger (tier 1)** — near-permanent on Gyro for the reposition/escape; the "blink out of the pack then finish them" pattern is the whole payoff.
- **Crystalys (tier 1)** — crit; Gyro's base damage after eating is so high that crits hit for 1.2k+.
- **Manta Style (tier 4)** — illusions inherit Gyro's ~6,000 HP, giving you two more super-tanks.
- **Lifesteal (Satanic / Vladimir's aura)** — sustain through drawn-out fights; take the 4-Warlock lifesteal route or a lifesteal item.
- **Minotaur Horn (tier 4)** on Magnus — instant stun after the Stampede charge.
- **Situational vs disable:** if opponents run disarm (Heaven's Halberd), hex, or silence against your one carry, grab **Linken's Sphere**. If they run Mind-Control Priest, a tier-1 **Gossamer Cape** on Gyro is mandatory.

## Relics

- **Stolen Vault** — reliable gold when no relic synergises; the guide notes it beats grabbing Magical Beans/Seed for this comp.

## Leveling / Roll Plan

Early game you can win-streak off 4-Ogre value (Anti-Mage as a fat off-tank) or lose-streak for econ — either is fine. Bank hard toward level 9 by around round 20 and hold gold; dismiss Demons before rolling to thin the legendary pool and improve your odds of a 2-star Gyrocopter. Keep an IO from early on so you can two-star Gyro the moment the second copy appears. Rounds 25–30 are the make-or-break window: prioritise the Ogre Hood over everything, take your items out to craft up to the tier-5 quickly, and don't panic-fuse. After the boss is online, level to 10–11 mostly for more bodies to feed and protect Gyrocopter.

## Positioning / Matchup Notes

Place Gyrocopter central with lower-level allies filling the four adjacent cells so the Ogre eat consumes them at fight start (a summoned/Stampeded-away unit like Enchantress may dodge the eat — keep sacrifice fodder immediately beside it). After transforming, Gyro tanks and cleans up while Beasts and Manta illusions body-block.

The clean counter is **Void** (Faceless Void's line / anything immune to debuffs): they strip the 6-Beast physical-damage debuff and shrug off Magnus's stun, so you fall back on pure Gyro damage and lifesteal to grind them out. Nine-Warrior reflect is also punishing until Gyro's HP pool is fully online.
